phases.title: Foundation and scientific repair

deliverables.description: Versioned architecture, protocol, and research harness

exit_criteria: Executable specification and test harness exist
phases.go_no_go_rule: Proceed only when the repository can distinguish planned, smoke-tested, and experimentally supported work.

phases.title: Claim and antecedent mapping

deliverables.description: Machine-readable Phase 0-7 roadmap and harness integration
Primary-source antecedent map for every registered claim
Resolve the remaining CAPQL full-text access gap

entry_criteria: Research question and candidate claims are registered
exit_criteria: Every claim has a closest antecedent and bounded novelty verdict
All essential papers are read in full or explicitly blocked
phases.go_no_go_rule: Do not freeze the pilot protocol until every claim is mapped and essential full-text gaps are resolved or formally excluded.

phases.title: Pilot calibration and protocol freeze

deliverables.description: Source-aware normalization and hypervolume calibration with no final-test feedback
Versioned budgets, seeds, checkpoints, and analysis plan

exit_criteria: Reward scaling and reference points use predeclared non-test calibration evidence
Course experiment matrix is frozen before final evaluation
phases.go_no_go_rule: No course-scale run until all analysis-sensitive quantities and budgets are frozen without final-test feedback.

phases.title: Mechanism diagnostics

deliverables.description: Validate compatible close baselines under Python 3.11
Behaviorally validate every declared dynamics shift

exit_criteria: Baseline failures are resolved or documented
Shift tests demonstrate intended transition changes
phases.go_no_go_rule: Do not interpret comparisons or OOD results until baselines and shifts pass qualification.

phases.title: Paired-seed course experiment matrix

deliverables.description: Uniform, matched-random, signal, combination, and close-baseline runs with paired seeds
Evidence-bounded course report with uncertainty and failure analysis

entry_criteria: Protocol, baselines, and dynamics shifts are qualified
exit_criteria: Raw and discounted vector returns retain provenance
phases.go_no_go_rule: Advance only if conclusions survive paired controls and are bounded to the executed course protocol.

phases.title: Course paper

deliverables.description: Course manuscript aligned with the claim registry
Reproducible configs, manifests, tables, and artifact instructions

exit_criteria: Every manuscript claim links to executed evidence
phases.go_no_go_rule: Do not broaden claims beyond the registered evidence or present the course matrix as publication-scale validation.

phases.title: Workshop and journal extension

deliverables.description: Additional environments, seeds, scales, and robustness checks
Predictive and causal tests that distinguish allocation signals

entry_criteria: Course report identifies a defensible signal or informative null result
exit_criteria: Publication-scale evidence covers external validity and mechanism
Claims and limitations are independently audited
phases.go_no_go_rule: Proceed to submission only when the extension changes evidence strength, not merely run count.

phases.title: Submission and artifact freeze

deliverables.description: Immutable code and artifact release with provenance

entry_criteria: Publication-scale evidence and internal audit are complete
exit_criteria: Archival artifact identifies exact code, configs, and result manifests
phases.go_no_go_rule: Release only artifacts that satisfy licensing, privacy, provenance, and reproducibility checks.
